name: teacher-gold5k-8gpu-20261023
description: Teacher targets for 5k train + 1k dev, direct+verify, 2 chains, 8192 tokens, include truncated
command:
set -uo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish
VS=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/.venv-startlux
V2=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/.venv-sii
CKPT=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/qz/grouped_bce_4gpu/v1/final
D=$R/data/multiselect_grouped_multi_5k
RUN=$R/runs/qz/teacher_gold5k_20261023
LOG=$R/logs/qz/teacher_gold5k.log
mkdir -p "$R/logs/qz" "$RUN"
cd "$R"
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
{
for VIEW in direct verify; do
  echo "===== VIEW $VIEW $(date -Is)"
  MODEL="$CKPT" CHECKPOINT_ID="sha256:ed5e1eee1b4aeeefecf7ae2ad0eacb5dfdade03ba294fab4f3fd05ec38ebfd6d" TEACHER_ID="gold-bce43:$VIEW" TEACHER_VIEW="$VIEW" \
  SHARDS=8 SAMPLES=2 SPLITS="train dev" LIMIT=0 DATA_DIR="$D" RUN_ROOT="$RUN" \
  MAX_TOKENS=8192 MAX_MODEL_LEN=16384 READOUT_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS=16384 MAX_PHASE_SECONDS=39600 \
  Q_TRANSFORM=membership TRUNCATED_POLICY=include  \
  PYTHON_GENERATE="$VS/bin/python" PYTHON_READOUT="$V2/bin/python" \
  bash "$R/harness/run_sii_style_teacher.sh" || { echo "VIEW $VIEW FAILED rc=$?"; exit 3; }
done
} > "$LOG" 2>&1
status=$?
echo "JOB EXIT=$status"
exit $status
